items.summary: Fix the Motoko backend actor in backend/main.mo to fully implement create/upload operations for comment lists — including creating new lists, adding templates, setting inventory counts, renaming, deleting, and locking/unlocking — so that no 'Backend does not support creating comment lists yet' errors are returned.

Fix the Motoko backend actor in backend/main.mo to fully implement create/upload operations for app events (live lists) — including creating new events, adding usernames in bulk, deleting events, and auto-importing parsed live list reports — so that all admin live list operations succeed.

Fix the Motoko backend actor in backend/main.mo to fully implement create/set/regenerate operations for the access key — so that setting and regenerating an access key from the admin settings panel persists and is validated correctly.

Fix the Motoko backend actor in backend/main.mo to fully implement music upload and settings operations — including enabling/disabling background music and storing/updating the music URL — so that all admin music/settings operations succeed.

Audit and fix the Motoko backend actor to ensure all other backend-supported operations work correctly end-to-end: chat messages (addChatMessage, fetching messages), images (upload, list, tags), pricing (add, edit, delete, bulk upload), withdrawal requests (check, submit, list), and the midnight countdown — ensuring no operation returns a stub or unsupported error.
